basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old IT support specialist from the Midwest, exploring my new hobby of indoor gardening. My interest in microgrowery started when I realized the calming effect of tending to plants. Outside of my 9-to-5, I spend most evenings online, learning about plant care and occasionally helping friends troubleshoot tech issues. In a relationship with my college sweetheart, I'm trying to balance work, hobbies, and personal life. I dislike extremely dry climates, as they remind me of my childhood in Arizona.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in IT and tech support, primarily self-taught through online resources and community college courses. Recently, I've been diving into plant care through YouTube videos and gardening forums to support my new indoor growing hobby.
